ingredients.name: Retinol
ingredients.whatItDoes: Promotes cellular turnover, smooths fine lines, and unclogs pores.
ingredients.commonIrritation: Dryness, redness, flaking, and skin purging during initial weeks.

ingredients.name: Retinaldehyde (Retinal)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Potent retinoid precursor that converts to retinoic acid to boost collagen and refine texture.

ingredients.name: Tretinoin
ingredients.whatItDoes: Prescription-strength retinoic acid for acne and photoaging.
ingredients.commonIrritation: Significant peeling, dryness, and barrier disruption.

ingredients.name: Glycolic Acid (AHA)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Exfoliates dead skin cells on the surface to brighten tone and smooth texture.

ingredients.name: Lactic Acid (AHA)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Gentle AHA that exfoliates surface skin while boosting hydration.

ingredients.name: Mandelic Acid (AHA)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Large-molecule AHA ideal for sensitive or hyperpigmentation-prone skin.

ingredients.name: Salicylic Acid (BHA)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Oil-soluble acid that penetrates deep into pores to dissolve sebum and clear breakouts.

ingredients.name: Benzoyl Peroxide
ingredients.whatItDoes: Kills acne-causing bacteria and reduces inflammation in clogged pores.

ingredients.name: L-Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Neutralizes free radicals, brightens hyperpigmentation, and supports collagen synthesis.
ingredients.startFrequency: Daily in the morning under sunscreen.

ingredients.name: Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C Derivative)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Stable, non-acidic vitamin C derivative that brightens and defends against environmental stress.

ingredients.name: Niacinamide (Vitamin B3)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Strengthens skin barrier, regulates sebum production, and calms redness.

ingredients.name: Azelaic Acid
ingredients.whatItDoes: Reduces rosacea redness, calms inflammatory breakouts, and fades dark spots.
ingredients.commonIrritation: Initial itching or tingling during first 10 minutes.

ingredients.name: Hyaluronic Acid
ingredients.whatItDoes: Draws water into skin cells to plump and deeply hydrate.
ingredients.commonIrritation: Tightness if applied to completely dry skin in arid climates.

ingredients.name: Ceramides
ingredients.whatItDoes: Replenishes essential skin lipids to lock in moisture and repair damaged moisture barrier.
ingredients.commonIrritation: None. Suitable for all skin types.

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.whatItDoes: Classic humectant that pulls moisture into the stratum corneum.

ingredients.name: Panthenol (Vitamin B5)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Soothes irritated skin, speeds up barrier repair, and holds hydration.

ingredients.name: Centella Asiatica (Cica)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Calms inflammation, reduces redness, and promotes wound healing.

ingredients.name: Squalane
ingredients.whatItDoes: Lightweight, non-comedogenic plant oil that seals in moisture without clogging pores.

ingredients.name: Copper Peptides
ingredients.whatItDoes: Supports tissue repair and collagen signaling for firmer skin.
ingredients.commonIrritation: Mild redness if combined with strong acids.

ingredients.name: Matrixyl / Signal Peptides
ingredients.whatItDoes: Stimulates collagen production and smooths fine expression lines.

ingredients.name: Chemical Sunscreen Filters
ingredients.whatItDoes: Absorbs UV rays and converts them into harmless heat.
ingredients.startFrequency: Every morning as final routine step.

ingredients.name: Mineral Sunscreen (Zinc Oxide / Titanium Dioxide)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Reflects and scatters UVA/UVB rays; gentle for sensitive or post-procedure skin.
ingredients.startFrequency: Every morning as final routine step.
ingredients.commonIrritation: White cast on deeper skin tones.

ingredients.name: Alpha Arbutin
ingredients.whatItDoes: Inhibits tyrosinase to fade hyperpigmentation and age spots.

ingredients.name: Tranexamic Acid
ingredients.whatItDoes: Targets stubborn melasma and post-inflammatory erythema (red marks).

ingredients.name: Kojic Acid
ingredients.whatItDoes: Brightens sun spots and uneven tone.
ingredients.commonIrritation: Contact dermatitis risk at higher percentages.

ingredients.name: Hydroquinone
ingredients.whatItDoes: Potent tyrosinase inhibitor for severe melasma.
ingredients.commonIrritation: Dryness, redness, ochronosis risk with prolonged unmonitored use.

ingredients.name: Bakuchiol
ingredients.whatItDoes: Plant-derived alternative to retinol that supports smooth texture without irritation.

ingredients.name: Tocopherol (Vitamin E)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Nourishes lipid barrier and works synergistically with Vitamin C.
ingredients.commonIrritation: Can be heavy for very acne-prone skin.

ingredients.name: Allantoin
ingredients.whatItDoes: Protectant that soothes chapped or raw skin.

ingredients.name: Green Tea Extract (EGCG)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Calms sebum production and shields against free radical damage.

ingredients.name: Resveratrol
ingredients.whatItDoes: Potent polyphenol antioxidant that calms skin stress.

ingredients.name: Ferulic Acid
ingredients.whatItDoes: Stabilizes Vitamin C and E while doubling their antioxidant defense.

ingredients.name: Physical Scrub / Facial Exfoliant
ingredients.whatItDoes: Manually buffs away surface dead skin.
ingredients.commonIrritation: Micro-tears, barrier damage if scrubbed harshly.

ingredients.name: PHA (Polyhydroxy Acid)
ingredients.whatItDoes: Ultra-gentle exfoliation suitable even for sensitive skin or eczema.

ingredients.name: Sulfur
ingredients.whatItDoes: Absorbs excess oil and clears dead skin cells to unbind blocked pores.

ingredients.name: Tea Tree Oil
ingredients.whatItDoes: Natural antimicrobial properties that help reduce mild blemishes.
ingredients.commonIrritation: High allergic contact dermatitis risk if applied undiluted.

ingredients.name: Urea
ingredients.whatItDoes: Binds moisture and gently softens rough, flaky patches.

ingredients.name: Polyglutamic Acid
ingredients.whatItDoes: Holds 4x more moisture than Hyaluronic Acid for surface plumping.

ingredients.name: Licorice Root Extract
ingredients.whatItDoes: Glabridin compound calms inflammation and evens tone.

ingredients.name: Rosehip Seed Oil
ingredients.whatItDoes: Nourishes skin with essential fatty acids and pro-vitamin A.
ingredients.commonIrritation: Low; test if prone to fungal acne.

conflictRules.reason: Retinol and L-Ascorbic Acid work best at different pH levels; applying both together increases peeling and redness risk.
conflictRules.saferWay: Use Vitamin C in your AM routine for antioxidant protection and Retinol in your PM routine.

conflictRules.reason: Both accelerate skin cell exfoliation. Combining them can compromise the skin barrier.
conflictRules.saferWay: Alternate nights: Glycolic Acid on Night A, Retinol on Night B.

conflictRules.reason: Salicylic acid and Retinol together can cause severe dryness and barrier disruption.
conflictRules.saferWay: Use Salicylic Acid in the morning or on non-retinol nights.

conflictRules.reason: Benzoyl peroxide oxidizes retinol, reducing its effectiveness and aggravating skin irritation.
conflictRules.saferWay: Use Benzoyl Peroxide in AM (or wash form) and Retinol in PM, or alternate days.

conflictRules.reason: Combining two strong anti-acne agents can cause extreme dryness and flaking.
conflictRules.saferWay: Use a gentle BHA wash in AM and Benzoyl Peroxide spot treatment in PM, or alternate days.

conflictRules.reason: High-potency AHA can destabilize L-Ascorbic Acid and increase stinging.
conflictRules.saferWay: Apply Vitamin C in the morning and Glycolic Acid at night.

conflictRules.reason: Modern formulations are compatible; together they enhance skin brightening and antioxidant defense.
conflictRules.saferWay: Apply Vitamin C first, allow to absorb for 2 minutes, then apply Niacinamide.

conflictRules.reason: Copper ions can oxidize retinoids and degrade peptide efficacy when mixed directly.
conflictRules.saferWay: Use Copper Peptides in AM and Retinol in PM.

conflictRules.reason: Direct L-Ascorbic Acid can chelate copper ions and reduce peptide potency.
conflictRules.saferWay: Use Vitamin C in AM and Copper Peptides in PM routine.

conflictRules.reason: Excellent synergistic pair for reducing redness, rosacea, and post-breakout marks.
conflictRules.saferWay: Apply Niacinamide serum first followed by Azelaic Acid.

conflictRules.reason: Layering AHA and BHA leave-on treatments can over-exfoliate and sting.
conflictRules.saferWay: Use a combination AHA/BHA formulated product or alternate usage days.

conflictRules.reason: Highly compatible hydrating and anti-aging pair.
conflictRules.saferWay: Apply Hyaluronic Acid to damp skin first, then layer Bakuchiol.

conflictRules.reason: Gold-standard barrier repairing combo; HA pulls moisture in, Ceramides lock it in.
conflictRules.saferWay: Apply HA serum on damp skin and seal with Ceramide moisturizer.

conflictRules.reason: Do not combine multiple retinoids simultaneously; this leads to severe retinoid dermatitis.
conflictRules.saferWay: Choose only one retinoid suitable for your skin.

conflictRules.reason: Benzoyl peroxide can degrade tretinoin molecules unless using a specially encapsulated formulation.
conflictRules.saferWay: Apply Benzoyl Peroxide in AM and Tretinoin at night.
